tooltips.bindDashboardDateRange: When enabled, the dashlet results are filtered by the date range selected in the dashboard header.
tooltips.dashboardDateRangeField: The date/datetime field used to apply the dashboard date range filter.
tooltips.showFilterInfo: When enabled, shows the currently-applied filter (e.g. date range) next to the count line on the dashlet card.
tooltips.countLinkEnabled: When enabled, clicking the count text (e.g. "8 opportunities") opens a modal listing the underlying records, honoring the dashlet's runtime filters and the dashboard date range.
